topic: How to check whether a startup program is real before applying
summary: On September 17, 2026, dhooooooh published a 627-word original dev.to article that teaches readers to verify startup offers against vendor pages, eligibility rules, dated facts, and Sourcey records.

observations.fact: Qualifying venture-backed startups from early stage through Series A can receive up to one year of Kiro Pro+ at no cost, with packages for up to 2, 10, or 30 users.
observations.quoted_value: Up to one year of Kiro Pro+ credits; packages for up to 2, 10, or 30 users

observations.fact: AWS Activate Portfolio credits are listed up to $200,000 for pre-Series B startups that apply with an AWS Activate Provider Org ID.
observations.quoted_value: Up to $200,000; pre-Series B; AWS Activate Provider Org ID

observations.fact: ActiveCampaign's Incubator Program is listed at 90% off an annual plan for the first year, subject to its startup and incubator conditions.
observations.quoted_value: 90% off the first year of an annual plan
